verses.he: וַיַּקְהֵ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶֽת־כָּל־עֲדַ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֵ֚לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽם׃
verses.ar: وَجَمَعَ مُوسَى كُلَّ جَمَاعَةِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَقَالَ لَهُمْ: «هَذِهِ هِيَ ٱلْكَلِمَاتُ ٱلَّتِي أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ أَنْ تُصْنَعَ:
verses.en: And Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said unto them: 'These are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that ye should do them.
verses.kjv: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These [are] the words which the LORD hath commanded, that [ye] should do them.
verses.web: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which Yahweh has commanded, that you should do them.

verses.he: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ תֵּעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּבַיֹּ֣ום הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֥ם קֹ֛דֶשׁ שַׁבַּ֥ת שַׁבָּתֹ֖ון לַיהוָ֑ה כָּל־הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה בֹ֛ו מְלָאכָ֖ה יוּמָֽת׃
verses.ar: سِتَّةَ أَيَّامٍ يُعْمَلُ عَمَلٌ، وَأَمَّا ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْسَّابِعُ فَفِيهِ يَكُونُ لَكُمْ سَبْتُ عُطْلَةٍ مُقَدَّسٌ لِلرَّبِّ. كُلُّ مَنْ يَعْمَلُ فِيهِ عَمَلًا يُقْتَلُ.
verses.en: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you a holy day, a sabbath of solemn rest to the LORD; whosoever doeth any work therein shall be put to death.
verses.kjv: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.
verses.web: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to Yahweh: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.

verses.he: לֹא־תְבַעֲר֣וּ אֵ֔שׁ בְּכֹ֖ל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּיֹ֖ום הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃ פ
verses.ar: لَا تُشْعِلُوا نَارًا فِي جَمِيعِ مَسَاكِنِكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلسَّبْتِ».
verses.en: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.'
verses.kjv: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
verses.web: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’”

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־כָּל־עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ مُوسَى كُلَّ جَمَاعَةِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ قَائِلًا: «هَذَا هُوَ ٱلشَّيْءُ ٱلَّذِي أَمَرَ بِهِ ٱلرَّبُّ قَائِلًا:
verses.en: And Moses spoke unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying: 'This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying:
verses.kjv: ¶ And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This [is] the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
verses.web: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded, saying,

verses.he: קְח֨וּ מֵֽאִתְּכֶ֤ם תְּרוּמָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כֹּ֚ל נְדִ֣יב לִבֹּ֔ו יְבִיאֶ֕הָ אֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.ar: خُذُوا مِنْ عِنْدِكُمْ تَقْدِمَةً لِلرَّبِّ. كُلُّ مَنْ قَلْبُهُ سَمُوحٌ فَلْيَأْتِ بِتَقْدِمَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ: ذَهَبًا وَفِضَّةً وَنُحَاسًا،
verses.en: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD, whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, the LORD'S offering: gold, and silver, and brass;
verses.kjv: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD: whosoever [is] of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.web: ‘Take from among you an offering to Yahweh. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as Yahweh’s offering: gold, silver, bronze,

verses.he: וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתֹולַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ וְעִזִּֽים׃
verses.ar: وَأَسْمَانْجُونِيًّا وَأُرْجُوَانًا وَقِرْمِزًا وَبُوصًا وَشَعْرَ مِعْزًى،
verses.en: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair;
verses.kjv: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ [hair],
verses.web: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

verses.he: וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים וַעֲצֵ֥י שִׂטִּֽים׃
verses.ar: وَجُلُودَ كِبَاشٍ مُحَمَّرَةً وَجُلُودَ تُخَسٍ وَخَشَبَ سَنْطٍ،
verses.en: and rams' skins dyed red, and sealskins, and acacia-wood;
verses.kjv: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
verses.web: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

verses.he: וְשֶׁ֖מֶן לַמָּאֹ֑ור וּבְשָׂמִים֙ לְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃
verses.ar: وَزَيْتًا لِلضَّوْءِ وَأَطْيَابًا لِدُهْنِ ٱلْمَسْحَةِ وَلِلْبَخُورِ ٱلْعَطِرِ،
verses.en: and oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense;
verses.kjv: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
verses.web: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

verses.he: וְאַ֨בְנֵי־שֹׁ֔הַם וְאַבְנֵ֖י מִלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפֹ֖וד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.ar: وَحِجَارَةَ جَزْعٍ وَحِجَارَةَ تَرْصِيعٍ لِلرِّدَاءِ وَٱلصُّدْرَةِ.
verses.en: and onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
verses.kjv: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
verses.web: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

verses.he: וְכָל־חֲכַם־לֵ֖ב בָּכֶ֑ם יָבֹ֣אוּ וְיַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֛ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ حَكِيمِ ٱلْقَلْبِ بَيْنَكُمْ فَلْيَأْتِ وَيَصْنَعْ كُلَّ مَا أَمَرَ بِهِ ٱلرَّبُّ:
verses.en: And let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded:
verses.kjv: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;
verses.web: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Yahweh has commanded:

verses.he: אֶת־הַ֨מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן אֶֽת־אָהֳלֹ֖ו וְאֶת־מִכְסֵ֑הוּ אֶת־קְרָסָיו֙ וְאֶת־קְרָשָׁ֔יו אֶת־בְּרִיחָ֕ו אֶת־עַמֻּדָ֖יו וְאֶת־אֲדָנָֽיו׃
verses.ar: ٱلْمَسْكَنَ وَخَيْمَتَهُ وَغِطَاءَهُ وَأَشِظَّتَهُ وَأَلْوَاحَهُ وَعَوَارِضَهُ وَأَعْمِدَتَهُ وَقَوَاعِدَهُ،
verses.en: the tabernacle, its tent, and its covering, its clasps, and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
verses.kjv: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.web: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;

verses.he: אֶת־הָאָרֹ֥ן וְאֶת־בַּדָּ֖יו אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֑רֶת וְאֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַמָּסָֽךְ׃
verses.ar: وَٱلتَّابُوتَ وَعَصَوَيْهِ، وَٱلْغِطَاءَ وَحِجَابَ ٱلسَّجْفِ،
verses.en: the ark, and the staves thereof, the ark-cover, and the veil of the screen;
verses.kjv: The ark, and the staves thereof, [with] the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,
verses.web: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;

verses.he: אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֥ן וְאֶת־בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃
verses.ar: وَٱلْمَائِدَةَ وَعَصَوَيْهَا وَكُلَّ آنِيَتِهَا، وَخُبْزَ ٱلْوُجُوهِ،
verses.en: the table, and its staves, and all its vessels, and the showbread;
verses.kjv: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,
verses.web: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;

verses.he: וְאֶת־מְנֹרַ֧ת הַמָּאֹ֛ור וְאֶת־כֵּלֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־נֵרֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֥מֶן הַמָּאֹֽור׃
verses.ar: وَمَنَارَةَ ٱلضَّوْءِ وَآنِيَتَهَا وَسُرُجَهَا وَزَيْتَ ٱلضَّوْءِ،
verses.en: the candlestick also for the light, and its vessels, and its lamps, and the oil for the light;
verses.kjv: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,
verses.web: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;

verses.he: וְאֶת־מִזְבַּ֤ח הַקְּטֹ֙רֶת֙ וְאֶת־בַּדָּ֔יו וְאֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֑ים וְאֶת־מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לְפֶ֥תַח הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.ar: وَمَذْبَحَ ٱلْبَخُورِ وَعَصَوَيْهِ، وَدُهْنَ ٱلْمَسْحَةِ وَٱلْبَخُورَ ٱلْعَطِرَ، وَسَجْفَ ٱلْبَابِ لِمَدْخَلِ ٱلْمَسْكَنِ،
verses.en: and the altar of incense, and its staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;
verses.kjv: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,
verses.web: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

verses.he: אֵ֣ת ׀ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֗ה וְאֶת־מִכְבַּ֤ר הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר־לֹ֔ו אֶת־בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־כַּנֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: وَمَذْبَحَ ٱلْمُحْرَقَةِ وَشُبَّاكَةَ ٱلنُّحَاسِ ٱلَّتِي لَهُ وَعَصَوَيْهِ وَكُلَّ آنِيَتِهِ، وَٱلْمِرْحَضَةَ وَقَاعِدَتَهَا،
verses.en: the altar of burnt-offering, with its grating of brass, its staves, and all its vessels, the laver and its base;
verses.kjv: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.web: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;

verses.he: אֵ֚ת קַלְעֵ֣י הֶחָצֵ֔ר אֶת־עַמֻּדָ֖יו וְאֶת־אֲדָנֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶחָצֵֽר׃
verses.ar: وَأَسْتَارَ ٱلدَّارِ وَأَعْمِدَتَهَا وَقَوَاعِدَهَا، وَسَجْفَ بَابِ ٱلدَّارِ،
verses.en: the hangings of the court, the pillars thereof, and their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;
verses.kjv: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,
verses.web: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

verses.he: אֶת־יִתְדֹ֧ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְאֶת־יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶחָצֵ֖ר וְאֶת־מֵיתְרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: وَأَوْتَادَ ٱلْمَسْكَنِ، وَأَوْتَادَ ٱلدَّارِ وَأَطْنَابَهَا،
verses.en: the pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords;
verses.kjv: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
verses.web: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;

verses.he: אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י הַשְּׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן׃
verses.ar: وَٱلثِّيَابَ ٱلْمَنْسُوجَةَ لِلْخِدْمَةِ فِي ٱلْمَقْدِسِ، وَٱلثِّيَابَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ لِهَارُونَ ٱلْكَاهِنِ، وَثِيَابَ بَنِيهِ لِلْكَهَانَةِ».
verses.en: the plaited garments, for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.'
verses.kjv: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy [place], the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.web: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’”

verses.he: וַיֵּ֥צְא֛וּ כָּל־עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֽ͏ֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִלִּפְנֵ֥י מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.ar: فَخَرَجَ كُلُّ جَمَاعَةِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ قُدَّامِ مُوسَى،
verses.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.kjv: ¶ And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
verses.web: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

verses.he: וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ כָּל־אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־נְשָׂאֹ֣ו לִבֹּ֑ו וְכֹ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נָדְבָ֨ה רוּחֹ֜ו אֹתֹ֗ו הֵ֠בִיאוּ אֶת־תְּרוּמַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה לִמְלֶ֨אכֶת אֹ֤הֶל מֹועֵד֙ וּלְכָל־עֲבֹ֣דָתֹ֔ו וּלְבִגְדֵ֖י הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.ar: ثُمَّ جَاءَ كُلُّ مَنْ أَنْهَضَهُ قَلْبُهُ، وَكُلُّ مَنْ سَمَّحَتْهُ رُوحُهُ. جَاءُوا بِتَقْدِمَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ لِعَمَلِ خَيْمَةِ ٱلِٱجْتِمَاعِ وَلِكُلِّ خِدْمَتِهَا وَلِلثِّيَابِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةِ.
verses.en: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and brought the LORD'S offering, for the work of the tent of meeting, and for all the service thereof, and for the holy garments.
verses.kjv: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, [and] they brought the LORD’s offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.
verses.web: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought Yahweh’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.

verses.he: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים עַל־הַנָּשִׁ֑ים כֹּ֣ל ׀ נְדִ֣יב לֵ֗ב הֵ֠בִיאוּ חָ֣ח וָנֶ֜זֶם וְטַבַּ֤עַת וְכוּמָז֙ כָּל־כְּלִ֣י זָהָ֔ב וְכָל־אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵנִ֛יף תְּנוּפַ֥ת זָהָ֖ב לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَجَاءَ ٱلرِّجَالُ مَعَ ٱلنِّسَاءِ، كُلُّ سَمُوحِ ٱلْقَلْبِ، جَاءَ بِخَزَائِمَ وَأَقْرَاطٍ وَخَوَاتِمَ وَقَلَائِدَ، كُلِّ مَتَاعٍ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ. وَكُلُّ مَنْ قَدَّمَ تَقْدِمَةَ ذَهَبٍ لِلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought nose-rings, and ear-rings, and signet-rings, and girdles, all jewels of gold; even every man that brought an offering of gold unto the LORD.
verses.kjv: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, [and] brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered [offered] an offering of gold unto the LORD.
verses.web: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to Yahweh.

verses.he: וְכָל־אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־נִמְצָ֣א אִתֹּ֗ו תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתֹולַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ וְעִזִּ֑ים וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים הֵבִֽיאוּ׃
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ مَنْ وُجِدَ عِنْدَهُ أَسْمَانْجُونِيٌّ وَأُرْجُوانٌ وَقِرْمِزٌ وَبُوصٌ وَشَعْرُ مِعْزًى وَجُلُودُ كِبَاشٍ مُحَمَّرَةٌ وَجُلُودُ تُخَسٍ، جَاءَ بِهَا.
verses.en: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair, and rams' skins dyed red, and sealskins, brought them.
verses.kjv: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ [hair], and red skins of rams, and badgers’ skins, brought [them].
verses.web: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.

verses.he: כָּל־מֵרִ֗ים תְּר֤וּמַת כֶּ֙סֶף֙ וּנְחֹ֔שֶׁת הֵבִ֕יאוּ אֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְכֹ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נִמְצָ֨א אִתֹּ֜ו עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֛ים לְכָל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת הָעֲבֹדָ֖ה הֵבִֽיאוּ׃
verses.ar: كُلُّ مَنْ قَدَّمَ تَقْدِمَةَ فِضَّةٍ وَنُحَاسٍ جَاءَ بِتَقْدِمَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ. وَكُلُّ مَنْ وُجِدَ عِنْدَهُ خَشَبُ سَنْطٍ لِصَنْعَةٍ مَا مِنَ ٱلْعَمَلِ جَاءَ بِهِ.
verses.en: Every one that did set apart an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD'S offering; and every man, with whom was found acacia-wood for any work of the service, brought it.
verses.kjv: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD’s offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought [it].
verses.web: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought Yahweh’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.

verses.he: וְכָל־אִשָּׁ֥ה חַכְמַת־לֵ֖ב בְּיָדֶ֣יהָ טָו֑וּ וַיָּבִ֣יאוּ מַטְוֶ֗ה אֶֽת־הַתְּכֵ֙לֶת֙ וְאֶת־הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֔ן אֶת־תֹּולַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וְאֶת־הַשֵּֽׁשׁ׃
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ ٱلنِّسَاءِ ٱلْحَكِيمَاتِ ٱلْقَلْبِ غَزَلْنَ بِأَيْدِيهِنَّ وَجِئْنَ مِنَ ٱلْغَزْلِ بِٱلْأَسْمَانْجُونِيِّ وَٱلْأُرْجُوَانِ وَٱلْقِرْمِزِ وَٱلْبُوصِ.
verses.en: And all the women that were wise-hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, the blue, and the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.
verses.kjv: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, [both] of blue, and of purple, [and] of scarlet, and of fine linen.
verses.web: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.

verses.he: וְכָל־הַ֨נָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָשָׂ֥א לִבָּ֛ן אֹתָ֖נָה בְּחָכְמָ֑ה טָו֖וּ אֶת־הָעִזִּֽים׃
verses.ar: وَكُلُّ ٱلنِّسَاءِ ٱللَّوَاتِي أَنْهَضَتْهُنَّ قُلُوبُهُنَّ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ غَزَلْنَ شَعْرَ ٱلْمِعْزَى.
verses.en: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats' hair.
verses.kjv: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats’ [hair].
verses.web: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.

verses.he: וְהַנְּשִׂאִ֣ם הֵבִ֔יאוּ אֵ֚ת אַבְנֵ֣י הַשֹּׁ֔הַם וְאֵ֖ת אַבְנֵ֣י הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפֹ֖וד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.ar: وَٱلرُّؤَسَاءُ جَاءُوا بِحِجَارَةِ ٱلْجَزْعِ وَحِجَارَةِ ٱلتَّرْصِيعِ لِلرِّدَاءِ وَٱلصُّدْرَةِ،
verses.en: And the rulers brought the onyx stones, and the stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
verses.kjv: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
verses.web: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;

verses.he: וְאֶת־הַבֹּ֖שֶׂם וְאֶת־הַשָּׁ֑מֶן לְמָאֹ֕ור וּלְשֶׁ֙מֶן֙ הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃
verses.ar: وَبِٱلطِّيبِ وَٱلزَّيْتِ لِلضَّوْءِ وَلِدُهْنِ ٱلْمَسْحَةِ وَلِلْبَخُورِ ٱلْعَطِرِ.
verses.en: and the spice, and the oil, for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
verses.kjv: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
verses.web: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

verses.he: כָּל־אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָדַ֣ב לִבָּם֮ אֹתָם֒ לְהָבִיא֙ לְכָל־הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לַעֲשֹׂ֖ות בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֑ה הֵבִ֧יאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל נְדָבָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃ פ
verses.ar: بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ، جَمِيعُ ٱلرِّجَالِ وَٱلنِّسَاءِ ٱلَّذِينَ سَمَّحَتْهُمْ قُلُوبُهُمْ أَنْ يَأْتُوا بِشَيْءٍ لِكُلِّ ٱلْعَمَلِ ٱلَّذِي أَمَرَ ٱلرَّبُّ أَنْ يُصْنَعَ عَلَى يَدِ مُوسَى، جَاءُوا بِهِ تَبَرُّعًا إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: The children of Israel brought a freewill-offering unto the LORD; every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which the LORD had commanded by the hand of Moses to be made.
verses.kjv: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
verses.web: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to Yahweh; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Yahweh had commanded to be made by Moses.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רְא֛וּ קָרָ֥א יְהוָ֖ה בְּשֵׁ֑ם בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן־אוּרִ֥י בֶן־ח֖וּר לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَقَالَ مُوسَى لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ: «ٱنْظُرُوا. قَدْ دَعَا ٱلرَّبُّ بَصَلْئِيلَ بْنَ أُورِي بْنَ حُورَ مِنْ سِبْطِ يَهُوذَا بِٱسْمِهِ،
verses.en: And Moses said unto the children of Israel: 'See, the LORD hath called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
verses.web: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, Yahweh has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

verses.he: וַיְמַלֵּ֥א אֹתֹ֖ו ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּחָכְמָ֛ה בִּתְבוּנָ֥ה וּבְדַ֖עַת וּבְכָל־מְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.ar: وَمَلَأَهُ مِنْ رُوحِ ٱللهِ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْفَهْمِ وَٱلْمَعْرِفَةِ وَكُلِّ صَنْعَةٍ،
verses.en: And He hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship.
verses.kjv: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
verses.web: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;

verses.he: וְלַחְשֹׁ֖ב מַֽחַשָׁבֹ֑ת לַעֲשֹׂ֛ת בַּזָּהָ֥ב וּבַכֶּ֖סֶף וּבַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.ar: وَلِٱخْتِرَاعِ مُخْتَرَعَاتٍ، لِيَعْمَلَ فِي ٱلذَّهَبِ وَٱلْفِضَّةِ وَٱلنُّحَاسِ،
verses.en: And to devise skilful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.kjv: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.web: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,

verses.he: וּבַחֲרֹ֥שֶׁת אֶ֛בֶן לְמַלֹּ֖את וּבַחֲרֹ֣שֶׁת עֵ֑ץ לַעֲשֹׂ֖ות בְּכָל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת מַחֲשָֽׁבֶת׃
verses.ar: وَنَقْشِ حِجَارَةٍ لِلتَّرْصِيعِ، وَنِجَارَةِ ٱلْخَشَبِ، لِيَعْمَلَ فِي كُلِّ صَنْعَةٍ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْتَرَعَاتِ.
verses.en: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all manner of skilful workmanship.
verses.kjv: And in the cutting of stones, to set [them], and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
verses.web: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.

verses.he: וּלְהֹורֹ֖ת נָתַ֣ן בְּלִבֹּ֑ו ה֕וּא וְאָֽהֳלִיאָ֥ב בֶּן־אֲחִיסָמָ֖ךְ לְמַטֵּה־דָֽן׃
verses.ar: وَجَعَلَ فِي قَلْبِهِ أَنْ يُعَلِّمَ هُوَ وَأُهُولِيآبُ بْنَ أَخِيسَامَاكَ مِنْ سِبْطِ دَانَ.
verses.en: And He hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.kjv: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, [both] he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
verses.web: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

verses.he: מִלֵּ֨א אֹתָ֜ם חָכְמַת־לֵ֗ב לַעֲשֹׂות֮ כָּל־מְלֶ֣אכֶת חָרָ֣שׁ ׀ וְחֹשֵׁב֒ וְרֹקֵ֞ם בַּתְּכֵ֣לֶת וּבָֽאַרְגָּמָ֗ן בְּתֹולַ֧עַת הַשָּׁנִ֛י וּבַשֵּׁ֖שׁ וְאֹרֵ֑ג עֹשֵׂי֙ כָּל־מְלָאכָ֔ה וְחֹשְׁבֵ֖י מַחֲשָׁבֹֽת׃
verses.ar: قَدْ مَلَأَهُمَا حِكْمَةَ قَلْبٍ لِيَصْنَعَا كُلَّ عَمَلِ ٱلنَّقَّاشِ وَٱلْحَائِكِ ٱلْحَاذِقِ وَٱلطَّرَّازِ فِي ٱلْأَسْمَانْجُونِيِّ وَٱلْأُرْجُوَانِ وَٱلْقِرْمِزِ وَٱلْبُوصِ وَكُلَّ عَمَلِ ٱلنَّسَّاجِ. صَانِعِي كُلِّ صَنْعَةٍ وَمُخْتَرِعِي ٱلْمُخْتَرَعَاتِ.
verses.en: Them hath He filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of workmanship, of the craftsman, and of the skilful workman, and of the weaver in colours, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any workmanship, and of those that devise skilful works.
verses.kjv: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, [even] of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
verses.web: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.
